facts.fact: The World Bank program document says the government "has launched" a national digital transformation strategy to expand broadband connectivity, modernise the legal and regulatory framework and invest in digital public infrastructure such as digital IDs and data exchange platforms; it names no adopting act or body, no date and no title, so the as_of is the document's published date.

systems.system: São Tomé and Príncipe Sustainable Development National Strategy 2026-2040 (ENDS)
STP Fiscal Sustainability, Energy Access and Digital Connectivity Development Policy Financing
systems.owner: World Bank (IDA grant of US$10 million to the government)

note: The national digital transformation strategy is mentioned once and unnamed; the document gives no date, period, text, delivery plan or report for it. Standing is recorded as announced because the verb is launched by the government with no act named.
